parsed.name: INHECO Thermoshake AC恒温振荡器
parsed.description: 这是一种实验室恒温振荡器，用于对样品板等容器进行加热与振荡混匀。设备可设置振荡转速和振荡轨迹，部分操作还包括样品板锁定/解锁，常用于样品孵育、混匀及温控处理。
parsed.description_en: This is a laboratory heater-shaker used to heat and shake sample plates and similar labware for mixing. It supports setting shaking speed and motion pattern, and some operations include plate locking/unlocking, making it suitable for incubation, mixing, and temperature-controlled sample handling.

actions.description: 开始按已设定参数进行振荡。
actions.description_en: Start shaking using the currently configured settings.

actions.description: 以指定转速和轨迹开始振荡。
actions.description_en: Start shaking at the specified speed and motion pattern.

actions.description: 检查设备是否支持样品板锁定功能。
actions.description_en: Check whether the device supports plate locking.
